episodes.title: Nikki Casanova: Trying to Be Good Enough to Be Loved (Testimony) | EP #82 (Pt 1)
episodes.description:
Nikki Casanova was ten years old when her mother told her who she was; an identity she struggled with for most of her life.

In Part 1 of her testimony, Nikki shares the story of her childhood. Marked by rejection, abuse, and loss she couldn't grieve. Not knowing how to earn the love she craved, the patterns she longed to escape began surfacing in her own life.

This is a story about the wounds we carry, the identities others place on us, and the questions that follow us into adulthood.

▶ Pt 2 - Available 9/21/26.

episodes.title: Chris Hensley: His Greatest Trial, Met by an Unexplainable Peace (Testimony) | EP #81 (Pt 2)
episodes.description:
Chris Hensley had only just found his footing in faith when his body started sending signals he couldn't ignore — and the diagnosis that followed reset everything he thought he understood about control. 
In Part 2 of his testimony, Chris opens up about his greatest trial, the journey that changed his perspective, and an unexpected calling on his and Claudia's home. 
Through it all, something steadied him that he can't fully explain, though he knew all along the source from whence it came.
This is a story about the power of prayer and the peace of God.

episodes.title: Chris Hensley: Going Through the Motions, Until He Fell to His Knees (Testimony) | EP #80 (Pt 1)
episodes.description:
In his childhood, Chris Hensley had brushes with church. Methodist with his own family, Pentecostal with the friends across the street, but the experience ranged from ok to scary. 

In Part 1 of his testimony, Chris opens up about decades where God simply wasn't part of the picture, the season his wife Claudia decided she was ready for that to change, and his honest admission that he professed the same, but didn't think he was at the same place.

Then, on an ordinary night, with a song playing in another room, something broke through that Chris still can't explain; he only knows that afterward, he needed Jesus, in his own words, to fix him.

This is a story about a God who shows up before we are looking for Him.

▶ Pt 2 - https://youtu.be/rB0bUO8bbD0

episodes.title: Sandy Bond: I Was Looking in People for What Only He Could Give (Testimony) | EP #79 (Part 2)
episodes.description:
Sandy Bond had spent her whole life agreeing with the facts about Jesus — but it wasn't until she was in her thirties that He finally became personal. 
In Part 2 of her testimony, Sandy opens up about the safe places she had always found "people collecting", the tender way God revealed that He was the one safe place she could never lose, and the call He gave her once she learned to lean on Him. 
Then loss visited her family again — and this time she was carried by a peace she still can't fully explain. This is a story about the one safe place that can never be taken away.

▶ Pt 1 https://youtu.be/d-CmS2pLU7c

Sandy Bond is a Licensed Professional Counselor who founded and leads Cypresswood Christian Counseling in Houston, walking with individuals, couples, and families through grief, trauma, anxiety, and life-threatening illness. Her heart is to offer Christ-centered counseling that brings healing from the inside out — you can find her and her team at cypresswoodchristiancounseling.com.

If you'd like to learn more about JH Outback head to their website at https://jhoutback.com. 

You can get more details about Bible Study Fellowship by going to their website at https://www.bsfinternational.org.

episodes.title: Sandy Bond: Grieving Alone With a Jesus I Had Never Really Met (Testimony) | EP #78 (Part 1)
episodes.description:
Sandy Bond was still a little girl when she learned how quickly everything can be taken away — and by the time she was a teenager, grief had already reshaped who she was. 
In Part 1 of her testimony, Sandy opens up about the losses that marked her childhood, the walls she built to survive them, and a season years into her marriage that had her wanting to walk away. 
In the middle of her lowest moment, something happened that she still can't fully explain — a moment so perfectly timed, the only possible answer, is God. 
This is a story about what's still standing when everything else falls apart.

This is the part of a testimony nobody tells.
